name: eval_ms_pipeline
description: Mass spectrometry acquisition parameter evaluation pipeline. Evaluates TopN, AGC Fill, injection time, identification rate, cleavage specificity, missed cleavages, peak width (FWHM), and MIT distribution from Thermo raw files and search results.

function.name: run_evaluation
function.description: Run the full evaluation pipeline for a configured dataset. Produces Word reports, figures, and summary TSVs.

dataset.description: Dataset name configured in DATASETS dict (e.g., 'Mga', 'NTM', '913')

lang.description: Report language: 'zh' for Chinese, 'en' for English (optional, auto-detected by default)

function.description: Add a new dataset configuration to the pipeline.

result_path.description: Path to search results (pFind result dir, msms.txt, results.sage.tsv, etc.)

label.description: Group label for report title. Chinese characters produce Chinese reports.

enzyme_rule.description: Enzyme cleavage rule: KR_C (Trypsin, cleaves after K/R) or KR_N (LysargiNase, cleaves before K/R)

fasta.description: Path to protein database FASTA (enables cleavage QC computation for non-pFind engines)

fraction_pattern.description: Regex to extract fraction number from raw filename (e.g., '_F(\\d+)_90min'). Use null for single-injection data.

id_pattern.description: Regex to extract (fraction, CV) from search result File_Name (e.g., '_F(\\d+)_(\\d+)V')

autolysis_pattern.description: Regex for enzyme protein IDs in Proteins column (e.g., 'CON_LysargiNase')

has_ms1.description: True if .ms1 files exist (uses XIC streaming for FWHM). Default false (uses rawdump --xic).

function.name: detect_engine
function.description: Auto-detect search engine from result file column names.

function.name: get_summary
function.description: Read and return the cross-group summary TSV after evaluation.
